title: The Two-Top Trick
sentences: A black bin sat off the mat.
The plan was for the red top to hit the black top.
Jo gave the red top a spin.
Bill gave the black top a spin.
The red top hit the black top.
The red top did a flip and fell flat.
The black top went off the mat and into the black bin.

comprehensionQuestion.question: What did the red top do after it hit the black top?
answers: It went into a red bag.
It did a flip and fell flat.
It came to a stop in a black bin.
